lines.text: [VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Ah! So this is where you were!
I thought you might have made your way to\nCinnabar Island by now.
You need to have [VAR COLOR(0006)]eight[VAR COLOR(0000)] Gym Badges to get into\nthe Pokémon League, right?
I’ve got seven already! Which means that the\nonly one left is...
Yeah! It must be the Gym in [VAR COLOR(0006)]Viridian City[VAR COLOR(0000)], right?\nIt was closed up last time I checked, though.
Have you been in the Viridian City Gym\nyet, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]?\r\nYou haven’t, right?
I guess I’ll try stopping by Viridian City one\nmore time.
